The result type is a [discriminated union](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/narrowing.html#discriminated-unions), so you can handle both cases conveniently. ```ts const result = Player.safeParse({ username: 42, xp: "100" }); if (!result.success) { result.error; // ZodError instance } else { result.data; // { username: string; xp: number } } ```
